en: A colored illustration showing a Renaissance-style courtyard framed by massive stone arches in the foreground. Behind the arch is an inner courtyard with arcaded galleries, an ornate staircase leading up under a small gabled roof, and a decorative fountain or well in the left background. The architecture features vaulted ceilings, pilasters, and balustrades typical of a European palace or castle. There is no visible printed caption, only a small artist's monogram and date-like mark in the lower left corner.
